long_runtime_grid:20100.grid_policy: group-M4 when n <= 2048 and m >= 4096; N-first otherwise

replacement_policy: Each refinement shape replaces its entire base worker result, including all OPUS candidates, external reference, registry, exclusions, GPU, and rounds. Other shapes retain their complete base result. Never take per-candidate minima or borrow missing timings across batches.
baseline_policy: Every shape compares against old25+old5 remeasured in its selected worker; old25 supplies membership only. The five original registered candidates remain available in every generic pool.
reference_policy: External winners come from the same selected worker as OPUS timings. Full and transferred-finalist policies remain explicit per shape. Reference binaries and measurement harness must be identical across both batches.
selection_policy: Reuse analyze_full295 greedy pruning against the merged generic+old5 envelope, preserving all envelope external wins and the per-shape tolerance. No fixed candidate-count target or global-minimality claim; this is an offline measured portfolio, not a timed dispatch.
metric_policy: Positive delta means slower; strict median latency comparison defines external wins. Geomeans weight shapes equally. Round counts and source GPU/run/batch are retained per shape; no rounds are pooled across batches.
measurement_policy: Base uses unchanged analyze_full295.audit_batch; refinement uses unchanged analyze_runtime_v2.audit_worker with local candidate metadata and old25|old5 coverage. Complete workers, references, protected/output hashes, registry eligibility, numerical checks, and raw-round reconstruction are audited.
